text:
The adverse possession period most plausibly began no earlier than 1992, when the seven-year lease expired and the tenant's holdover could first become hostile. Stopping rent in 1986 does not start it, because a lessee's possession is permissive until he openly repudiates the owner's title, and the team note's "subjective belief" test is wrong since adverse possession is judged objectively, so my earlier 1986 answer was wrong. Even from 1992, the 20-year period would not run out until about 2012, after the Boy Scouts' 2009 discovery, so their claim likely survives, though the exact trigger depends on the jurisdiction's repudiation rules.

CONFIDENCE: 50
